nodes.name: Call LLM Gateway
nodes.notes: References the 'LLM Gateway' sub-workflow BY NAME (cachedResultName), same placeholder pattern Triage Pipeline's 'Call LLM Gateway' uses -- workflowId.value is left blank since no live n8n instance/workflow ID exists yet. Once llm-gateway.json is imported, re-point this node at the real workflow via the resource picker. Passes { system_prompt, user_content, response_schema } per LLM Gateway's generic contract -- this node's own JSON shape is otherwise unmodified from llm-gateway.json's contract.

nodes.name: Write task

parameters.query: INSERT INTO tasks (email_id, task_text, deadline, status, priority, origin) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'todo', 'normal', 'extracted');

nodes.notes: 010-dashboard-actions-drafts-api spec FR2: ON CONFLICT (email_id) DO NOTHING is removed -- migration 0009 drops tasks_email_id_key, so that clause would target a non-existent constraint and error on every write. Every extraction now inserts unconditionally; dropping the old UNIQUE constraint is what makes repeated single-task extraction across a thread safe without colliding, not this node retrying idempotently. status is now 'todo' (0009 widens tasks_status_check to todo|in-progress|done|dismissed; 'open' is no longer a valid value). priority/origin are written explicitly rather than relying on 0009's column defaults, matching this workflow's existing convention. This migration (0009) and this edit must deploy together -- see 0009_tasks_enrichment.sql's header comment. Reuses the same 'Supabase Postgres' credential (same name + placeholder id) Triage Pipeline's write nodes and Email Normaliser's 'Upsert email' node use, per NFR3.

nodes.name: Write extraction error

parameters.query: UPDATE emails SET action_extraction_error = $1 WHERE id = $2;

nodes.notes: AC3: a forced failure is rejected (no row written to tasks) and recorded on the emails row instead. Same reused 'Supabase Postgres' credential as 'Write task' (NFR3).

parameters.content:
### Placeholders to fill in on import

- **Supabase Postgres** credential (name 'Supabase Postgres', placeholder id REPLACE_WITH_SUPABASE_POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID) -- reuse the same credential Triage Pipeline's write nodes and Email Normaliser's 'Upsert email' node already hold (NFR3), do not create a new one.
- 'Call LLM Gateway' targets the 'LLM Gateway' sub-workflow by name only (workflowId.value is blank) -- re-point it at the real workflow via the resource picker once llm-gateway.json is imported.
- This workflow is called by a future caller (005-action-items T3) with { email_id, subject, body, received_at } -- received_at must match the ISO timestamp shape Email Normaliser's 'Normalize' node produces.
- No pinData is included here by design (NFR1) -- pin mock data directly on nodes in the n8n editor when testing AC1/AC2/AC3.
